ov: Shelled reptiles, about 360 species, including land-living tortoises, freshwater terrapins and sea turtles. Sea turtles are the only reptiles that migrate long distances to lay their eggs.

why.h: Turtles don’t truly hibernate, but some can lie dormant for months (brumation).
why.p: Some land and freshwater species are widely kept as pets.
why.et: Hunted for meat, traditional medicine and shells.

rg: Most continents and some islands, plus much of the ocean in the case of sea turtles.
fx: The leatherback, the largest turtle, is also the fourth-largest living reptile.
